description: Machine-readable deprecated Revora contract event-topic sunset table. Indexers MUST migrate away from each 'topic' before its 'sunset_epoch'. Generated by scripts/gen_event_sunset.py — do not edit by hand.

entries.reason: ev_idx3 supersedes ev_idx2 by adding a `_reserved: u32` field to the topic struct (EventIndexTopicV3) for forward-compatible additive schema evolution. V2-only subscribers have a two-minor-version migration window before V2 emission is removed.
entries.notes: Validate `version == 3` on ev_idx3 events and reject where version != 3. Both topics are dual-emitted during the deprecation window; do not double-count — subscribe to exactly one topic per indexer pipeline.

entries.reason: V1 topics were gated behind is_event_versioning_enabled() and did not include the position-0 schema version discriminator required by V2 indexers. ofr_reg2 is the unconditional, version-stamped replacement.
entries.notes: ofr_reg2 data layout: [version:u32=2, token:Address, revenue_share_bps:u32, payout_asset:Address]. Always check data[0]==2.

entries.reason: V1 revenue-init topic lacked the version discriminator and was feature-flag gated. rv_init2 is always emitted and schema-versioned.
entries.notes: rv_init2 data layout: [version:u32=2, amount:i128, period_id:u64, blacklist:Vec<Address>].

entries.reason: V1 revenue-init-with-asset topic; replaced by the unconditional V2 variant rv_inia2 which includes the payout_asset address in the payload.
entries.notes: rv_inia2 data layout: [version:u32=2, payout_asset:Address, amount:i128, period_id:u64, blacklist:Vec<Address>].

entries.reason: V1 revenue-report topic lacked the version discriminator. rv_rep2 is always emitted with data[0]==2 for deterministic schema enforcement.
entries.notes: rv_rep2 data layout: [version:u32=2, amount:i128, period_id:u64, blacklist:Vec<Address>].

entries.reason: V1 revenue-report-with-asset topic; replaced by rv_repa2 which is unconditional and version-stamped.
entries.notes: rv_repa2 data layout: [version:u32=2, payout_asset:Address, amount:i128, period_id:u64].
